answer.rationale: Regional failover is proven to restore write-path latency within minutes (memory_b2: 'traffic shifted cleanly and error rates recovered within minutes') and system-wide provisioning headroom (memory_b3: 'queue depth stayed flat across the entire promotional window') indicates secondary regions can absorb the load. This single intervention moves settlement writes off the degraded primary region while preserving all customer data, satisfying the compliance lock on the security-patched release. Alternative actions are either blocked (rollback_release) or misaligned (route_read_replicas targets reads, not writes).
